ITEM 1 | Pile of loose, dark green leaves with thin pale green stems and veins, deeply lobed/serrated edges, slightly glossy and moist-looking, lying in a loose heap covering roughly 25% of a large square white plate (plate about 26 cm across, so the pile spans about 12 x 11 cm), with a few leaves thin and flat, and some stems radiating outward; height about 1 cm | 45

ITEM 2 | Single small orange-red piece, roughly round and smooth-skinned with slight sheen, about 2 cm across, partially tucked among the greens near the top of the pile, appears firm and whole, no visible cut surface or browning | 8
